svg.title: Team Health Check
svg.desc: A3 landscape team health check: eleven dimensions, each with healthy and unhealthy descriptions, green/amber/red dot-vote cells, a trend indicator and space for notes and actions.
svg.text: How healthy is our team right now, and which way is it trending? Vote, discuss, then pick 1–2 areas to improve.
Inspired by the Spotify Squad Health Check · Team & Facilitator Tool · Systems-Thinking Approach
We deliver great stuff and customers are delighted.
We deliver poor work and feel uneasy shipping it.
Releasing is simple, safe, painless and automated.
Releasing is risky, manual, painful and slow.
We love coming to work and have fun together.
Clean, readable code with great test coverage.
Technical debt is out of control.
We're learning interesting things all the time.
We never have time to learn anything.
We know why we're here and we're excited about it.
No clear purpose, big picture or focus.
We control our destiny: we decide what and how.
We're pawns with no influence on what we do.
We get things done quickly. No waiting, no delays.
We keep getting stuck, blocked or interrupted.
Our way of working fits us perfectly.
Our way of working gets in our way.
We get great help and support when we ask.
We get stuck because we can't get the help we need.
We're a gelled team with awesome collaboration.
We're individuals who don't really know each other.
“Which 1–2 areas would make the biggest difference if they got 1% better?”
Vote with coloured dots · Repeat each PI to see trends · Feed red/amber areas into the 1% Experiment Canvas
